name: pfarok
transitions: real->protected (CR0.PE 0->1, far-jump to 32-bit flat code segment 0x08)
GDT: null + code0 0x08 + data0 0x10 + code0 0x18 (the far-CALL target segment)
PROTECTED-MODE FAR CALL: lcall ptr16:32 to 0x18:far_target -- pushes CS:next_eip,
loads CS from the GDT descriptor, transfers
FAR RETURN: lret pops CS:EIP and comes back to the caller's segment
witness ebp: 0x00000000 never transferred / 0xFA000001 reached the target but did
why: REVIEW2_aug2 C-06 prerequisite. verify-sys had NO far-CALL golden: psocfarcall/psoccallfmem/psocpmretf are referenced by zero gates AND have no source (.bin/.elf/.o only), so they cannot be rebuilt or registered. pcallsel covers the REJECT path only. This is the positive case, so a reorder of the far-transfer path (C-06's remaining half) has something to regress against.
